_about: N6 owner-approved eligibility edits atop the N5 pool edits. Frozen accepted engine and all historical edits remain untouched. Dedicated capabilities and both gate directions are the only new executable engine changes; no draw algorithm or combat math changes.

edits.name: Swift: the overlay's three-tier ladder (totals 0.08 / 0.20 / 0.35)
Keen Eye: retired (leaves the pool in place)
Magnetic Core: the overlay's three-tier ladder (radius totals 0.15 / 0.30 / 0.50; burst set to 0.10 / 0.20 / 0.30)
edits.replace:
id: "v13_magnetic_core", name: "Magnetic Core", tag: .neutral,
            description: "+15% XP pull; XP gives a speed burst",
            apply: { stats in
                stats.pickupRadiusMultiplier += 0.15
                stats.magneticCoreSpeedBoost = 0.10
            },
            higherTiers: [
                { stats in
                    stats.pickupRadiusMultiplier += 0.30 - 0.15
                    stats.magneticCoreSpeedBoost = 0.20
                },
                { stats in
                    stats.pickupRadiusMultiplier += 0.50 - 0.30
                    stats.magneticCoreSpeedBoost = 0.30
                }
            ]
        ))

edits.name: XP Boost: the overlay's three-tier ladder (totals 0.25 / 0.50 / 0.50; T3 raises the run cap to 20 and owes one level)
edits.replace:
id: "neutral_5", name: "XP Boost", tag: .neutral,
            description: "+25% XP gain",
            apply: { stats in stats.xpMultiplier += 0.25 },
            higherTiers: [
                { stats in stats.xpMultiplier += 0.50 - 0.25 },
                { stats in
                    stats.xpMultiplier += 0.50 - 0.50
                    stats.runLevelCap = max(stats.runLevelCap, 20)
                    stats.grantedLevelsPending += 1
                }
            ]
        ))

edits.name: Long Shot: the overlay's four-tier ladder (range totals 0.25 / 0.50 / 0.50 / 0.50; tiers 1–4)
Scatter: the overlay's four-tier ladder (lanes 2 / 3 / 5 / 9; no spreadAngle write)
Fracture Shot: the overlay's four-tier ladder (fractureTier 1–4; the split fields are gone)
edits.find:
apply: { stats in stats.splitCount = 2 },
            provides: [.pelletEffect],          // v2.1 A7a (CL-93, symmetric)
edits.replace:
apply: { stats in stats.fractureTier = 1 },
            higherTiers: [
                { stats in stats.fractureTier = 2 },
                { stats in stats.fractureTier = 3 },
                { stats in stats.fractureTier = 4 }
            ],
            provides: [.pelletEffect],          // v2.1 A7a (CL-93, symmetric)

edits.name: Rapid Fire: the overlay's five-tier ladder (rate ratios to +10/+25/+50/+90 %; T5 the beam) with the R4 tier gates (T5 provides pelletEffect, blocked by glacialCondensation)
edits.replace:
id: "neutral_3", name: "Rapid Fire", tag: .neutral,
            description: "+10% attack speed",
            apply: { stats in stats.fireRateMultiplier /= (1 + 0.10); stats.rapidFireTier = 1 },
            higherTiers: [
                { stats in stats.fireRateMultiplier *= (1 + 0.10) / (1 + 0.25); stats.rapidFireTier = 2 },
                { stats in stats.fireRateMultiplier *= (1 + 0.25) / (1 + 0.50); stats.rapidFireTier = 3 },
                { stats in stats.fireRateMultiplier *= (1 + 0.50) / (1 + 0.90); stats.rapidFireTier = 4 },
                { stats in stats.rapidFireTier = 5 }
            ],
            tierProvides: [5: [.pelletEffect, .chaosBeam]],
            tierBlockedBy: [5: [.glacialCondensation, .beamIncompatible]]
        ))

edits.name: N5 Chain Reaction: three tiers (R6) — T1 explode + tier 1; T2 base 2, radius 50; T3 base 3, radius 70 (the escalation reads the tier)
N6 dedicated capability cases
edits.replace:
case pelletEffect
        case chaosBeam
        case beamIncompatible

edits.name: N6 void_1 symmetric beam gate
edits.find:
id: "void_1", name: "Warp Shot", tag: .voidT,
            description: "Slow shots that speed up. Slower = more damage.",
            apply: { stats in stats.warpShotActive = true },
            detail: "Your primary shots launch at 40% speed and reach full speed after 0.6s. They deal 150% damage at launch, falling to 100% at full speed. Damage between whole numbers rounds up by chance.",
            provides: [.pelletEffect],          // v2.1 A7a (CL-93, symmetric)
            requires: [.voidUnlocked],
            blockedBy: [.glacialCondensation]   // v2.1 A7a (CL-93): pellets only
        ))
edits.replace:
id: "void_1", name: "Warp Shot", tag: .voidT,
            description: "Slow shots that speed up. Slower = more damage.",
            apply: { stats in stats.warpShotActive = true },
            detail: "Your primary shots launch at 40% speed and reach full speed after 0.6s. They deal 150% damage at launch, falling to 100% at full speed. Damage between whole numbers rounds up by chance.",
            provides: [.pelletEffect, .beamIncompatible],          // v2.1 A7a (CL-93, symmetric)
            requires: [.voidUnlocked],
            blockedBy: [.glacialCondensation, .chaosBeam]   // v2.1 A7a (CL-93): pellets only
        ))
